title: Death Note: The Complete Saga
world_rules: The Death Note is a supernatural notebook — any human whose name is written in it will die.
The writer must know the face and name of the person to kill them.
Shinigami Eyes allow the user to see any person's real name and remaining lifespan, but cost half the user's remaining lifespan.
If a Death Note owner gives up ownership, they lose all memories of using it.
A shinigami who uses the Death Note to extend a human's life will die.

node_47.prose: In an alternate timeline, Light and L set aside their differences. L agrees: the justice system is broken. Together, they use the Death Note surgically — only targeting verified serial killers and war criminals. The world changes, slowly, carefully. Two geniuses working together instead of against each other.

node_45.prose: In the Shinigami Realm, far above the human world, other death gods discuss what happened. A shinigami named Sidoh complains that his notebook was stolen years ago — the very notebook Mello used. The cycle of death continues, even without Kira.

node_43.prose: Light staggers out of the warehouse, bleeding. He collapses on a metal staircase in an abandoned building. Ryuk hovers above him. 'Well, Light, it's been fun. But this is where it ends.' Light looks up in horror. 'Ryuk... you wouldn't...'

node_5.prose: Light burns the Death Note in his backyard. The pages curl and blacken. A shadowy figure — the shinigami Ryuk — watches from above, amused. 'Humans are so interesting,' he mutters, and returns to the Shinigami Realm to drop another notebook somewhere else.

node_14.prose: L dispatches 12 FBI agents to Japan to shadow potential Kira suspects. One of them — Raye Penber — is assigned to follow Light Yagami. Light notices the tail within days.
character_states: Light is being followed by FBI

node_23.prose: Misa Amane — a famous model and Second Kira — appears. She gained a Death Note from the shinigami Rem and made the Shinigami Eyes deal. She can see L's real name. Obsessed with Kira for killing the man who murdered her family, she tracks Light down and offers herself as his weapon.
established_facts: shinigami Rem will kill anyone who threatens Misa

node_29.prose: Higuchi, a Yotsuba Group executive, uses the Death Note to kill business rivals. Light — now memory-wiped and genuinely innocent — works with L to catch this new Kira. They're allies for the first time, truly. L even admits: 'You're my first friend, Light.'
character_states: Light and L are genuine friends

node_39.prose: Light screams: 'Mikami! Write their names! NOW!' Mikami pulls out the notebook and writes frantically. 40 seconds pass. Nobody dies. Near smiles coldly. 'We replaced the notebook pages. This is a fake.' Mikami breaks down: 'God... why isn't it working?!'

node_1.prose: Light Yagami, top student in Japan, sits bored in class. Through the window, he watches a black notebook fall from the sky and land in the school courtyard. Written on the cover: 'Death Note.'
character_states: Light is a normal high school student
Light is bored and disillusioned with the world
established_facts: Death Note fell from the sky

node_13.prose: Light holds back. He suspects a trap. When Tailor finishes speaking and nothing happens, L's voice comes through: 'Interesting. Perhaps Kira is smarter than I thought.' Without confirming the killing method, L has fewer leads. The investigation stalls.
established_facts: L has less information about Kira

node_10.prose: Light refuses the deal. 'I'll find people's names my own way,' he tells Ryuk. The shinigami shrugs. 'Suit yourself. This is getting interesting either way.' Meanwhile, across the world, someone notices the pattern of deaths. The world's greatest detective has taken the case.

node_32.prose: Light manipulates events so that L's investigation threatens Misa's life. Rem, bound by her love for Misa, has no choice — she writes L's name and Watari's name in her Death Note. L collapses. His last sight is Light standing over him, smiling. 'I win, L.' Rem crumbles to dust — a shinigami who killed to save a human dies.
established_facts: Light takes over as the new L

node_7.prose: Light hides the Death Note in a locked drawer and tries to forget. But at night, he can still see Otoharada's face collapsing on the TV screen. The guilt eats at him. Five days later, a grotesque shinigami named Ryuk appears in his bedroom, grinning.
established_facts: Ryuk followed the notebook to Light

node_17.prose: Naomi Misora, Raye Penber's fiancée and a brilliant former FBI agent, begins investigating on her own. She deduces that Kira was on the bus with Penber. She walks into the NPA headquarters to share her findings — and runs directly into Light Yagami in the lobby.
established_facts: Naomi deduced Kira was on the bus

node_27.prose: Light voluntarily surrenders to L and is locked in a cell. Before confinement, he secretly gives up ownership of the Death Note — erasing all his memories of being Kira. In his cell, Light genuinely believes he is innocent. He IS innocent. The old Light is gone.
character_states: Light has no memory of being Kira

node_28.prose: Light writes 'L Lawliet' in the Death Note. 40 seconds pass. Somewhere in the investigation headquarters, L clutches his chest. His eyes widen. He falls from his chair. The world's greatest detective is dead. But without L, someone worse will come.

node_35.prose: Light tells L everything. About the Death Note. About Ryuk. About his vision for a crime-free world. L listens in silence. Then: 'You're the most brilliant, most dangerous person I've ever met. And you're my only friend. I'll give you 24 hours to stop — or I'll arrest you.'

node_8.prose: Ryuk, the shinigami, finally reveals himself to Light. His skeletal grin fills the room. 'I dropped that notebook because I was bored,' he says. 'I'm not on your side or anyone's. I'm just here to watch.' He offers Light a deal: Shinigami Eyes — the ability to see anyone's real name just by looking at them.
established_facts: Shinigami Eyes cost half remaining lifespan

node_36.prose: Light hands the Death Note to L. His memories fade like a dying dream. He forgets Kira, forgets the killings, forgets everything. And so Light Yagami lives as an ordinary man — brilliant, bored, ordinary. L locks the Death Note away forever. The killings stop. The world moves on.

node_46.prose: Another Death Note falls from the sky. It lands in a schoolyard in New York City. A young girl picks it up. She reads the cover. She smiles. The cycle begins again.
established_facts: a new Kira may be born

node_24.prose: Light stops all killings. For weeks, no criminals die. But then — criminals start dying again while Light is under 24/7 surveillance. Someone else has a Death Note. L is confused. Light proposes a radical plan: imprison me. If killings continue while I'm locked up, I'm innocent.
character_states: Light is willing to be confined
established_facts: evidence points to a corporate group

node_9.prose: Light's eyes glow red for a brief moment. Now, above every person he sees, their true name and remaining lifespan float in crimson text. The power is intoxicating — no one can hide their identity from him. But he's already sacrificed half his life.
established_facts: Light can see anyone's real name

node_12.prose: Tailor clutches his chest and dies on live television. Then the REAL L's voice speaks through a distorted filter: 'I had Tailor say that — he was a criminal sentenced to die today. You just proved Kira exists, that you're in Kanto, and that you need a face and a name to kill. Thank you, Kira.'
character_states: L knows Kira is in Kanto
established_facts: Kira needs a name and face

node_26.prose: Light pushes Misa away. She's devastated but the shinigami Rem grows hostile. Rem threatens Light: 'If you make Misa unhappy, I will write YOUR name in my Death Note.' Light now has an enemy he literally cannot outmaneuver — a god of death.
established_facts: Rem will kill Light if Misa is unhappy

node_15.prose: Light orchestrates a bus hijacking to force Raye Penber to show his FBI ID. Then, using that name, Light manipulates Penber into writing the names of all 12 FBI agents on pages from the Death Note. Penber dies on a train, watching Light's smiling face as the doors close.
established_facts: all FBI agents died of heart attacks

node_11.prose: A worldwide broadcast interrupts every channel. A man calling himself 'L' directly challenges Kira: 'Kira, I know you're in Japan. And I will find you.' But it's a trap — the man on screen is Lind L. Tailor, a condemned criminal used as L's decoy.
established_facts: broadcast targets Kanto region of Japan

node_22.prose: Light avoids the task force. Without inside information, he can't predict L's moves. L, meanwhile, deploys surveillance everywhere. Light becomes increasingly paranoid, working alone against the world's greatest detective without any advantage.
established_facts: Light has no inside information on L

node_21.prose: Light joins the task force alongside his own father, Soichiro Yagami. He now has access to everything L knows. But L has cameras in Light's bedroom. Every move is watched. The cat-and-mouse game intensifies to unbearable levels.
character_states: Light is on the task force
L has cameras in Light's room
established_facts: Light must hide the Death Note

node_4.prose: A hostage situation plays live on TV. Light writes the criminal's name: Kurou Otoharada. He waits. 40 seconds later, the man collapses — dead of a heart attack. Light's hands tremble. The notebook is real.
character_states: Light killed for the first time

node_19.prose: Light avoids Naomi, but she successfully delivers her findings to L. L now knows Kira was on the Spaceland bus with Raye Penber. The list of suspects narrows dramatically — and Light Yagami is at the top.

node_30.prose: With L dead, Light reigns as Kira for five years. Crime drops 70%. Wars end. The world worships and fears him equally. But two orphans from Wammy's House — Near and Mello — have inherited L's legacy. They're coming for Kira.

node_37.prose: Near arranges a final confrontation at the Yellow Box warehouse. He claims to have proof that Light is Kira. Light is confident — Mikami has the notebook and will write everyone's name at his signal. Everything has been planned to the second.

node_31.prose: The task force corners Higuchi in a car chase. He's captured. But when Light touches the Death Note recovered from Higuchi — his memories return in a flood. Every death. Every manipulation. Every lie. Light Yagami remembers he is Kira. The mask goes back on. No one notices.
established_facts: touching the Death Note restored Light's memories

node_42.prose: Light breaks. All the composure, all the masks, all the calculations — gone. He screams at everyone in the warehouse: 'I AM KIRA! And? What's wrong with that? I've been cleansing this world! I'm the god of the new world!' The task force stares at the boy they once trusted. His father's legacy in ruins.
established_facts: Light admitted to being Kira publicly

node_44.prose: Ryuk grins his skeletal grin one final time. 'I told you from the very beginning, Light — I would be the one to write your name.' He opens his shinigami notebook. In elegant script, he writes: Light Yagami. 40 seconds. Light's eyes go wide. His heart stops. The genius who tried to become a god dies alone on a cold staircase. Kira is dead.

node_41.prose: Light pulls a tiny scrap of Death Note from his hidden watch compartment. He pricks his finger and starts writing Near's name in blood. Matsuda sees it. 'LIGHT!' A gunshot rings out. The bullet tears through Light's hand. The paper falls. Matsuda fires again. And again.
established_facts: Light tried to use hidden Death Note scrap

node_3.prose: Light walks past the notebook. Later that evening, another student — a quiet, troubled boy named Teru Mikami — picks it up instead. Within weeks, criminals begin dying of heart attacks across Japan. Light watches the news, unaware of what he almost held in his hands.
character_states: Light never touched the Death Note

node_25.prose: Misa sees L's face and reads the name floating above his head: L Lawliet. She whispers it to Light. For the first time, Light holds L's fate in his hands. He could write it right now and end everything.
established_facts: L's real name is L Lawliet

node_20.prose: L introduces himself to Light directly — at university, under the alias 'Ryuzaki.' He says he's working with the police on the Kira case. Light realizes this is L testing him face to face. Both geniuses smile at each other, each hiding everything.

node_33.prose: Light continues working alongside L, biding his time. But L is too perceptive. During a quiet moment on the rooftop in the rain, L says: 'Light... I know you're Kira. I've always known. But I could never prove it.' The rain falls between them.
established_facts: L believes Light is Kira but has no proof

node_34.prose: Light operates as both Kira and the new 'L' for five years. Crime plummets. He builds a new world order with Misa and a devoted follower named Teru Mikami handling the killings. But L left successors: Near, a cold logical genius, and Mello, an emotional wildcard. They know 'L' died years ago.
character_states: Light is both Kira and L

node_6.prose: Over the next days, Light systematically writes the names of violent criminals. Dozens die of heart attacks. The public notices. The media gives the unknown killer a name: 'Kira.' Some worship him as a god of justice. Others call him a monster.

node_16.prose: Light acts like a perfect student. He attends cram school, helps his father with police work, and never touches the Death Note while being watched. Weeks pass. The FBI finds nothing and withdraws from Japan. But L remains suspicious — the one person who was too perfect.
established_facts: L suspects Light is too clean

node_2.prose: Light picks up the notebook and reads the rules inside. 'The human whose name is written in this note shall die.' He scoffs — it has to be a sick joke. But that night, alone in his room, curiosity overwhelms him.

node_18.prose: Light pretends to be a fellow investigator. Through careful conversation, he manipulates Naomi into revealing her real name. He writes it in the Death Note hidden in his jacket. She walks away — and never arrives at the police station. Her body is never found. She was programmed to die by suicide in a location where she won't be discovered.

node_40.prose: Near opens the notebook and reads the names inside. Every name matches a criminal Kira killed. Then he reveals the writing analysis: Teru Mikami's handwriting. And embedded in the pages — Light Yagami's fingerprints from when he originally owned it.
established_facts: fingerprint evidence links Light to Death Note

node_38.prose: Light relies entirely on Mikami. But Mikami is too devoted — he acts independently, visiting the bank where the real Death Note is hidden. Mello's mafia contacts notice. They photograph Mikami at the bank. Near now knows where the real notebook is.
character_states: Mikami exposed the real notebook's location
established_facts: Near knows about the real notebook
